{"id":1513408240,"question_id":680,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 6 months","timestamp":1737279469,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"5 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1513408240/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Valid Palindrome II","memory":"22.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool checkPalindrome(string &s , int i ,int j )\n    {\n        while(i<=j)\n        {\n            if(s[i] != s[j])\n            return false;\n            else\n            {\n                i++;\n                j--;\n            }\n        }\n    return true;\n    }\n    bool validPalindrome(string s) {\n\n        int i = 0;\n        int j = s.length()-1;\n        \n        while(i<=j)\n        {\n            if(s[i] == s[j])\n            {\n                i++ ; \n                j-- ;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                bool deletion_i = checkPalindrome(s,i+1,j);\n\n                bool deletion_j = checkPalindrome(s,i,j-1);   \n\n                return deletion_i || deletion_j;\n            }\n        }\n    return true;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"valid-palindrome-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":189}
